reference_families.publisher: MINCETUR · Inventario Nacional de Recursos Turísticos
reference_families.people_activity: arrival and gathering potential; exact cadence not established
reference_families.edge_background: external public terrace, glazed mass and La Cultura civic cluster
reference_families.proves: The official inventory defines an external public terrace as one of three principal architectural zones, making arrival space part of the building rather than leftover foreground.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current crowd rhythm, the strongest non-frontal position or unrestricted professional photography.

reference_families.people_activity: audience arrival, accessible cultural participation and performance attendance
reference_families.edge_background: theater entrance, Javier Prado and La Cultura station under 100 metres away
reference_families.proves: The current official site corroborates active programming and a close transit-to-theater threshold that can produce architecture-caused audience flow.
reference_families.cannot_prove: A specific 2026 performance exit density, exact asset persistence or a safe curbside camera position.

reference_families.people_activity: rehearsing, preparing, guiding and operating performances
reference_families.edge_background: rehearsal rooms, dressing rooms, stage and technical circulation
reference_families.proves: The theater is a working spatial system whose rooms and workers enable the public spectacle, not only an iconic shell.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Public access to those positions during a field visit or permission to photograph backstage activity.

reference_families.people_activity: exhibiting, meeting, participating and attending outdoor events
reference_families.edge_background: three gallery volumes, terrace, park and urban edge
reference_families.proves: The institution explicitly frames its industrial architecture as surrounded by an active terrace and park, supporting a building-to-public-life scene rather than an isolated object.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current water level, repeatable gesture or the least saturated camera position.

reference_families.people_activity: event use zones documented, not a live event
reference_families.edge_background: central building, two water mirrors, garden, terrace and perimeter paths
reference_families.proves: The published plan verifies that the water mirrors and garden are structural parts of the spatial composition and identifies paths from which layered views can be tested.
reference_families.cannot_prove: 2026 maintenance state, reflections, public circulation or photographic visibility from ground level.

reference_families.people_activity: visiting exhibitions, learning, gathering and attending events
reference_families.edge_background: museum thresholds, terrace and landscape used as program space
reference_families.proves: The current institution remains active and offers time-dependent occupation that can change the meaning of the park and threshold.
reference_families.cannot_prove: A particular event's photography policy, attendance or exact 2026 field window.

reference_families.people_activity: museum occupation documented historically; no present gesture proved
reference_families.edge_background: 18th-century house with salvaged railings, doors, columns, beams and corbels
reference_families.proves: The official history establishes the building as an adaptation assembled partly from recovered architectural elements, creating a real old/new and whole/fragment relationship.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Which recovered element is visually legible from a public position or current visitor density.

reference_families.people_activity: walking, pausing and dining potential; occupancy not current evidence
reference_families.edge_background: garden, café terrace, courtyard planting and white architectural surfaces
reference_families.proves: The official 360-degree route allows position study across garden, café and architecture rather than relying on one promotional angle.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current bloom, crowd behavior, exposure range or permission for a competition-oriented session.

reference_families.people_activity: entering, viewing, studying visible storage and using terraces
reference_families.edge_background: ramps, rooms, gardens, café terrace and controlled circulation
reference_families.proves: The current page corroborates active routes through rooms and gardens and states that ordinary personal photography is allowed while tripods, selfie sticks and photo sessions are not.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Authorization for the intended competition workflow, a quiet window or professional-equipment interpretation; verify directly before field use.

reference_families.people_activity: ascending, visiting and learning; exact flow not established
reference_families.edge_background: superposed platforms, reconstructed access ramp, museum and surrounding towers
reference_families.proves: The official district page identifies the ramp and three occupation phases and explicitly documents the monument's contrast with surrounding modern buildings.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current tower occlusion, best anti-postal relation or 2026 visitor cadence.

reference_families.people_activity: visitor route implied, not a live occupancy record
reference_families.edge_background: archaeological platforms, paths and site museum collection
reference_families.proves: The ministry's virtual route supports advance position study and connects the outdoor monument with the museum's material evidence.
reference_families.cannot_prove: Current access, temporary closures, people density or exact field light.

reference_families.edge_background: lit stepped adobe mass, dark sky and tree silhouette
reference_families.proves: A municipal record shows that artificial light can reduce the site to stepped mass and shadow, a materially different seeing mode from daytime urban contrast.
reference_families.cannot_prove: That the same lighting operates in 2026, public opening after dark or a safe exterior position.
